name: Blinding Spell (Metamagic)
body:
The magical energy you discharge affects your target’s vision.

Benefit: The target(s) of a blinding spell are blinded for 1 round. If the spell offers a saving throw, passing that save negates the blindness.

A blinding spell uses up a spell slot one level higher than the spell’s actual level.
